# SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURES — NOT RESEARCH DATA

Every file in this directory is invented for tests. None of it was collected from a provider, none of it
describes a real token, wallet, trade or post, and none of it may be imported into the observation store,
a release, an article or a page. Addresses are syntactically valid placeholders. Field paths in the x4o2
samples are assumptions made for testing the adapters' semantics; they are not the providers' real
response shapes, which have not been observed (docs/data/providers.json: fieldMapVerified=false).
